acceptance_criteria: Alert channel for no-log kits specified (or dropped) and reflected in EVENTS.md, p6-client, p6-ingest and p7-live-stuck
description:
ARCHITECTURE.md section 8 and p7-live-stuck say that for kits with logging off, stuck alerts still reach the facilitator, held in memory and never stored. But EVENTS.md client rule 5 says that when logging is off the client clears its queue and stops queueing, and server rule 2 (and p6-ingest) say ingest returns 204 and writes nothing. As written, a no-log kit's 'I'm stuck' press is never sent, so the alert cannot be shown.

Needed: a separate in-memory alert path (endpoint, payload, retention in memory, what the no-log invariant test asserts about it), or drop live alerts for no-log kits. This touches CLAUDE.md rule 2, so it needs a human decision.

Filed during beads setup (prompt 01, step 8).
title: DECISION: how live stuck alerts reach the facilitator for kits with logging off
